title: CreateDesignAutofillJobRequest
description:
Body parameters for creating a new autofill job. Use the `type` discriminator to choose
the autofill mode:

- Use `create_from_brand_template` to create a new design from a brand template.

NOTE: For backward compatibility, if `type` isn't specified in the request,
the request type is assumed to be `create_from_brand_template`.

ColumnConfig.description: Configuration for a data table column.

name.description: Name for the column, displayed as header text.

ColumnDataType.description: Expected data type for cells in this column.
x-enum-descriptions: Media data (such as images, videos, or combinations of both)
Mixed data types (use where the column contains cells of a combination of data types)

CreateFromBrandTemplateAutofillJobReques.description: Create a new autofilled design from a brand template.

type.description: For backward compatibility, if `type` isn't specified in the request, the request type is assumed to be `create_from_brand_template`.

brand_template_id.description: ID of the input brand template.

title.description:
Title to use for the autofilled design.

If no design title is provided, the autofilled design will have the same title as the brand template.

data.description: Data object containing the data fields and values to autofill.

CreateFromDesignAutofillJobRequest.description: Create a new autofilled design from an existing design that contains autofill data fields.

design_id.description: ID of the design to use as the autofill source.

title.description:
Title to use for the autofilled design.

If no design title is provided, the autofilled design will have the same title as the source design.

data.description: Data object containing the data fields and values to autofill.

DataTable.description:
Tabular data, structured in rows of cells.

- Each cell must have a data type configured.
- All rows must have the same number of cells.
- The number of entries in `column_configs` must match the number of columns in the data.

column_configs.description: Column definitions with names and data types.

DataTableAiDisclosure.description: A disclosure identifying if the app generated this media asset using AI.
x-enum-descriptions: App creates or significantly alters content using AI
No AI involvement in creation or alteration

DataTableImageMimeType.description: The MIME type of an image file that's supported by Canva's backend.

DataTableImageUpload.description: Options for uploading an image asset.

url.description:
The URL of the image file to upload.
This can be an external URL or a data URL.

thumbnail_url.description:
The URL of a thumbnail image to display while the image is queued for upload.
This can be an external URL or a data URL.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

DataTableRow.description: A single row of tabular data.

cells.description:
Cells of data in row.

All rows must have the same number of cells.

DataTableVideoMimeType.description: The MIME type of a video file that's supported by Canva's backend.
x-enum-descriptions: GIFs are treated as videos, not images.

DataTableVideoUpload.description: Options for uploading a video asset.

url.description: The URL of the video file to upload.

thumbnail_image_url.description:
The URL of a thumbnail image to use as a fallback if thumbnailVideoUrl isn't provided.
This can be an external URL or a data URL.

thumbnail_video_url.description: The URL of a thumbnail video to display while the video is queued for upload.

width.description: The width of the video in pixels.

height.description: The height of the video in pixels.

DatasetChartValue.description:
If the data field is a chart.

Note the following behavior:
- If `column_configs` is not provided, the first row is assumed to contain column headers where applicable.
- Chart autofill supports a maximum of 100 rows and 20 columns.
- `number` cells with formatting metadata are not currently supported for autofill and will result in an error response.
- `media` cells are not supported for chart autofill and will result in an error response.

DatasetImageValue.description: If the data field is an image field.

asset_id.description: `asset_id` of the image to insert into the template element.

DatasetSheetValue.description:
If the data field is a sheet element.

Note the following behavior:
- `number` cells with formatting metadata are not currently supported for autofill and will result in an error response.
- `media` cells are not supported for sheet autofill and will result in an error response.

DatasetTextValue.description: If the data field is a text field.

text.description: Text to insert into the template element.

DatasetVideoValue.description: If autofilling a video into an image data field.

asset_id.description: `asset_id` of the video to insert into the template element.

DateDataTableCell.description:
A date tabular data cell.

Specified as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

value.description:
Media collection values.

Provide an empty array for an empty cell.

formatting.description:
Formatting pattern using Office Open XML Format.

These patterns control how numbers are displayed to users, including currency symbols,
decimal places, and separators.

UpdateDesignAutofillJobRequest.description: Autofill an existing design in place with the provided data.

design_id.description: ID of the design to autofill in place.

data.description: Data object containing the data fields and values to autofill.
